name: Isodecyl palmitate
description: Isodecyl palmitate (CAS 59231-33-3 ) is a synthetic ester of palmitic acid and isodecanol used as an emollient, lubricant, and plasticizer across personal care and industrial formulations. Its low viscosity and skin-compatible profile make it a preferred ingredient where light-textured conditioning is required without greasiness. In personal care, it functions as an emollient carrier. It is used in lotions, creams, and color cosmetics, contributing smooth spreadability and skin feel without heavy residue. Coating and adhesive formulators incorporate it as a plasticizer and processing aid. This helps to improve film flexibility and substrate wetting. In metalworking and industrial lubricant blends, it acts as a base fluid or co-lubricant where a biodegradable ester alternative is preferred. It serves as an alternative to mineral oil and supports emulsification in leave-on and rinse-off cosmetic systems. This aids in the dispersion of oil-phase components for stable formulations. Isodecyl palmitate is supplied as a clear, low-viscosity liquid. It is available in cosmetic-grade and technical-grade specifications to meet the requirements of personal care manufacturers. Industrial users can also utilize these specifications for various applications. Packaging typically ranges from drums to IBC totes for bulk procurement to ensure efficient supply chain logistics.
